about: Source-grounded synthetic challenge cases for the RCEP check. Expected labels were derived by oracle.py from the cited primary rule rows and treaty clauses, not by running the candidate engine. Cases were authored by the implementer with knowledge of the engine interface; this is not blind authoring and not independent real-world customs rulings.
label_method: oracle.py over the cited rule rows; hand-specified rows are marked in the case rule field

rcep-ch3.title: RCEP Agreement, Chapter 3 Rules of Origin, Articles 3.2 to 3.7
rcep-ch3.note: The local RCEP agreement PDF is image-only and the single fetch of the chapter text returned 404, so article numbers follow the engine's pinned citations and the ABF guide; the clauses were not re-read in this lane.
